The left graph has a y-axis labeled "Средни леглодни (дни)" (Average Length of Stay in Days), with a linear scale from 200 to 260 days, marked at intervals of 20 days. The red line on this graph starts at approximately 250 days in 2008, decreases to around 240 days by 2012/2013, further drops to about 220 days by 2017, and then slightly increases to roughly 230 days by 2021.

The right graph has a y-axis labeled "Структурен ефект върху леглата" (Structural Effect on Beds), with a linear scale from 1.0 to 2.5, marked at intervals of 0.5. The red line on this graph begins at approximately 1.5 in 2008, rises to around 2.0 by 2012/2013, drops to about 1.0 by 2017, and then increases again to roughly 2.0 by 2021.

Both graphs display a red line with black data points, connected by straight line segments, illustrating the trend over the specified years.
